metadata.name: GetInventoryTransferReceipt
metadata.description: Use this API to view the receipt of the transferred inventory.

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked Example: 1.3 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of sender Example:  10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source from where API Call is initiated. CoreCard have multiple value of source for internal system (CoreMoney, SelfService, IVR, MobileSelfService) For external system expected source will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller Id of source from where API is initiated. It is End User phone number. Example: 7204454214 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called Id of destination for which API is initiated. It is Corecard IVR number. Example: 7314145404 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ANI
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: DNS
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Flag to retrieve error message in specific language Example: 'en' for English Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: RequestDate
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM-DD-YYYYTHH:MM:SS Example:- 11-12-2021T13:05:10 Allowable Values: 19

response_fields.name: Message
response_fields.description: Returns Error Message in case of Error.

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: Returns result of API processing. If any error is found then value will be 'false' else 'true'.

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Returns Error Code in case of Error.

response_fields.name: ResponseData
response_fields.description: This is group of below data elements.

children.name: OrderID
children.description: Order number for an inventory. Valid values : 0-9 Example : 3478

children.name: ProductID
children.description: ID of the Account's Product Valid Values:0-9 Example: 1739,1758

children.name: ProductName
children.description: Name of the Account's Product Valid Values:0-9, A-Z Example: Cash card

children.name: Quantity
children.description: Number of cards ordered in inventory Valid values - 0-9 Example : 850

children.name: TransferredBy
children.description: Userid of the user who transferred inventory Valid values - 0-9, a-z Example - Admin

children.name: TransferredOn
children.description: Date of Transfer for inventory cards Format: yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss Example: 2017-09-26T00:00:00

children.name: SourceBranchName
children.description: Source Branch Name Valid values - a-z, 0-9 Example: meca way Branch

children.name: SourceBranchNameCode
children.description: Source  Branch Code Valid values - 0-9, a-z Example - C8745

children.name: DestinationBranchName
children.description: Destination Branch Name Valid values - a-z, 0-9 Example: meca way Branch

children.name: DestinationBranchNameCode
children.description: Destination Branch Code Valid values - 0-9, a-z Example - C8745

children.name: CardNumberFrom
children.description: Beginning Range  of Card number Valid values: 0-9 Example: 4601001741741741

children.name: CardNumberTo
children.description: Ending range of card number Valid values: 0-9 Example: 4610017417417416

children.name: ProxyNumberFrom
children.description: Beginning range of Proxy Number. Valid values: 0-9 Example: 1001741741741

children.name: ProxyNumberTo
children.description: The Proxy number till where a transaction shall be initiated Valid values: 0-9 Example: 1001741741741

children.name: ShippingMode
children.description: Shipping Method to send cards valid values 0=Standard 1=Priority 2=Overnight Example : 0

children.name: AWBNumber
children.description: Air Way Bill Number of an inventory transfer Valid values: 0-9 Example: 156463

children.name: ReceiptStatus
children.description: Status of the inventory Valid values: Transfer Received Transfer - Lost in Transit Transfer - Damaged in Transit Transfer Received with Return Example: Transfer Received

children.name: ReceiptStatusDate
children.description: Date on which inventory marked received or lost in transit Format: yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss Example:2017-09-26T00:00:00
